passage.label: Given clear conquest; Allah forgive preceded sin follow complete favour guide straight path; aid mighty victory; sent down tranquillity hearts believers increase faith along present faith; Allah belong soldiers heavens earth ever Allah Knowing Wise; admit believing men women gardens rivers flow abide eternally remove misdeeds ever that sight Allah great attainment; punish hypocrite men women polytheist men women assume about Allah assumption evil nature; upon them misfortune evil nature Allah angry cursed prepared Hell evil destination; Allah belong soldiers heavens earth ever Allah Exalted Might Wise; sent you witness bringer good tidings warner; people believe Allah Messenger honor him respect Prophet exalt Allah morning afternoon; pledge allegiance you actually pledging allegiance Allah hand Allah over their hands; breaks word only breaks detriment himself; fulfills promised Allah give great reward

arabicExcerpts.text: لِّيَغۡفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعۡمَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡكَ وَيَهۡدِيَكَ صِرَٰطٗا مُّسۡتَقِيمٗا
هُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ لِيَزۡدَادُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنٗا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمۡۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمٗا
لِّيُدۡخِلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمٗا

وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوۡءِۚ عَلَيۡهِمۡ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوۡءِۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَنَهُمۡ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَسَآءَتۡ مَصِيرٗا
وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُۚ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلًا

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوۡقَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَوۡفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيۡهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤۡتِيهِ أَجۡرًا عَظِيمٗا

mainSubject.label: Clear conquest granted so that Allah may forgive prior and future sin, complete His favour, guide to a straight path and aid with mighty victory; tranquillity sent into believers' hearts increasing their faith, with cosmic soldiers belonging to Allah the Knowing Wise; believing men and women admitted to rivered gardens eternally with misdeeds removed as great attainment; hypocrites and polytheists of both sexes punished for assuming evil of Allah, earning His anger, curse and Hell as evil destination; soldiers of heavens and earth reaffirmed under the Mighty Wise; the Prophet sent as witness, bringer of good tidings and warner so that people believe, honour, respect and exalt Allah morning and afternoon; pledging allegiance to the Prophet identified as pledging to Allah whose hand is over theirs, breaking it harming only oneself while fulfilling it earning great reward

subordinateSubjects.label: Clear conquest granted to the Prophet

Believing men and women admitted to rivered gardens eternally with misdeeds removed as great attainment
Hypocrite and polytheist men and women punished for assuming evil of Allah
Evil-natured misfortune, divine anger, curse and Hell prepared for them as evil destination
Soldiers of heavens and earth reaffirmed under the Exalted in Might, the Wise
The Prophet sent as witness, bringer of good tidings and warner so that people believe, honour, respect and exalt Allah morning and afternoon

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُۚ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلًا
commandsAndProhibitions.description: That you may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honour him and respect the Prophet and exalt Allah morning and afternoon.

notes: Wave 7 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the pledge-allegiance-to-Allah sequence (10) before the bedouin-excuses block opens (11); P2 ends with the imminent-conquest-and-booty promise (19) plus the competence affirmation (20-22 contextually linked); P3 runs from the unchanging sunnah through the Masjid al-Haram restraint, the vision confirmation, the Messenger's universal mission and the closing companion-description with reward (23-29). Note: P2 includes verses 20-22 as part of the booty-and-competence continuation despite the thematic shift, keeping the passage count at 3 for this 29-verse surah.
